subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should #95612 stay separate as a managed-run Claude CLI auth/runtime bug, or be folded into the separate expired-token re-auth-hint work tracked by #97553?
rationale: The source path and docs support a real OpenClaw-owned workflow, but only live Claude CLI OAuth service-context proof can decide whether the next fix belongs in OpenClaw's cli-backend/auth boundary or upstream in Claude Code.

options.title: Keep separate and live-reproduce
options.body: Keep #95612 open, run a maintainer-controlled cron/LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth reproduction, and fix the concrete OpenClaw boundary if the managed child invocation is responsible.

options.title: Treat as messaging-only after confirmation
options.body: Let the #97553 PRs handle the re-auth hint only if the reporter or maintainer proof shows the managed-only 401 no longer occurs after re-auth.

options.title: Route upstream after proof
options.body: If live proof shows Claude Code rejects valid OAuth only under launchd/MCP service context with identical OpenClaw inputs, document the upstream boundary and close with that evidence.

recommendation.title: Keep separate and live-reproduce
recommendation.body: Keep #95612 open, run a maintainer-controlled cron/LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth reproduction, and fix the concrete OpenClaw boundary if the managed child invocation is responsible.

likelyOwner.reason: The managed Claude CLI auth/backend path history is the closest owner signal for deciding whether the live-session/auth boundary belongs in OpenClaw.
